name: Featheria Online
source:
While all players are visiting Featheria in order to have fun, you are an virgin, stuck at home reading visual novels after an part-time job at an convenience store. After wishing to live in Featheria, you and your Belgian friend Maddox illegally entered Featheria where you and him are being pressured by hard labour by the corrupt Featheria guards and the goddess saves you both. 

[From [url=https://holyshit.itch.io/featheria1] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当所有玩家来到Featheria都是为了找乐子时，你却是个处女，在便利店打完工后，只能呆在家里看视觉小说。在希望住在费瑟里亚之后，你和你的比利时朋友马多克斯非法进入了费瑟利亚，在那里你和他受到腐败的费瑟利亚守卫的苦役压力，女神拯救了你们俩。

[来自[url=https://holyshit.itch.io/featheria1] itch.io[/url]]
